create_quantization_recipe: create an AutoRoundModifier quantization recipe targeting Linear layers with FP8_DYNAMIC scheme
run_quantization_oneshot: run the oneshot quantization pipeline with a model, calibration dataset, and AutoRoundModifier recipe
build_calibration_dataset: build a calibration dataset from a tokenizer with a specified sequence length and sample count
test_quantized_model_generation: test a quantized model by generating text completions and verifying output
save_compressed_quantized_model: save a quantized model and processor to disk in compressed format
